claims.claim: This sewing machine is in a very good condition, just buy and use.
claims.evidence: Witness only reports visible exterior items (machine, cover, pedal, attachment). No test run or functional checks were shown.
Witness report does not show a country-of-origin marking clearly enough to confirm 'Japanese made'.
No powered-on or sound/operation test is included in the witness observations.

claims.claim: All accessories and the original manual are included.
claims.evidence: Witness only notes one small attachment piece on the table; no manual or full accessory set is shown.

claims.claim: Never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No service history documentation or internal inspection is shown.

risks.risk: It may not stitch properly (timing/needle/bobbin alignment issues) even if it looks clean.
risks.proof: A short test video stitching a straight line on fabric, showing feed, tension, and consistent stitch formation.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not confirmed working; treated as a used machine with unknown stitch performance.

risks.risk: Motor/drive may be weak or noisy under load (smoothness claim not verifiable).
risks.proof: Clip of the motor running while sewing (not just idle), with audible noise level and steady speed.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown motor health; worst-case assumed to need servicing.

risks.risk: Missing essential parts (presser feet, bobbins, needles, thread guides, power cable completeness) not visible in the photos.
risks.proof: A laid-out inventory photo/video showing every included accessory (bobbin(s), presser feet set, needles, thread guide parts, power cable, manual if present).

risks.risk: Foot pedal or power cable may be faulty or incomplete.
risks.proof: Video showing pedal control (speed changes) and that the machine powers reliably with the pedal.

risks.risk: Exact model/serial number not readable; could be an older or less desirable variant.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the model plate/serial number label on the machine body.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the worst-case for an unidentified Singer sewing machine (older/unknown variant).

risks.risk: Hidden damage (cracks, rust, bent needle bar, worn gears) not visible from the exterior.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the needle area, feed dogs, underside/hinges, and any visible wear points; plus a brief internal inspection if possible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as exterior-only condition; hidden defects possible.

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of the model/serial number plate (label) on the machine body.
Send a short video of a full test run sewing on fabric (straight stitch and a turn), showing tension and consistent stitches.
Show the power cable and confirm the foot pedal works (speed increases/decreases on pedal).
Provide an inventory photo/video of all included accessories (bobbin(s), presser feet set, needles, thread guides, extension/attachments) and the original manual if claimed.
response.reason: The witness confirms it is a Singer-branded sewing machine with a pedal and one attachment, but there is no proof of working condition, completeness of accessories/manual, or motor performance. Without a test run and accessory inventory, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
